short: a picture in passes: which way, base first, model families, LoRAs

about.zh: 一张图分几步画时怎么拿主意：先出底图给你挑、什么时候两个模型必须是同一类、你选的画风 LoRA 要不要带到第二个模型上。具体有哪些路子、各自什么时候用，AMB 从上面能用的做法里现列给 AI，数值也在做法里。你存过的路线卡和搭配优先原样用，你没选的画风和 LoRA 不加。
about.en: The judgment for a picture made in passes: the base shown first for you to pick, when two models must be of one family, whether your style LoRA goes onto the second model too. Which ways there are and when each fits, Anomalous lists for the AI from the ways above that can run here; the values live in them. A route card or combo you saved comes first, as it is; no style or LoRA you did not pick.

text: Use when the user wants a picture made in passes, or one model for the composition and another for the look (style, skin, texture), or one for the character and another for the scenery; not a default for every picture.

A route the user saved is the daily run: a workflow card (list_workflows; "name / preset" when it has presets) or a combo (list_combos), with their subject and seed; its models, LoRAs and values are theirs, unchanged. Another route is another card. Never add a style, artist or LoRA the user did not pick.

Show the first pass before the second, so the user can pick the base: run_workflow with base_only=true (and batch for a few to choose from) runs that pass alone as previews; Anomalous keeps the one picked and holds its seed, so the next run_workflow runs the whole workflow on that base. Without base_only, set the base sampler's control_after_generate to "fixed" before that first run, or the second pass lands on another base.

Which way: "ways" lists those this ComfyUI can run now, as add_nodes takes them, each with when to take it. Two ideas are behind them. A lock: a guide holding the picture (Tile) lets a redraw go much stronger, adding detail or changing the look while the composition holds; without one a strong redraw moves the pose and ornaments. The whole picture first: a pose and what it rests on are drawn together on one model, then another redraws all or a part of it; a character drawn apart and pasted onto a scene does not sit on its bench.

Families: a step that reuses the first stage's prompts and VAE needs a second model of the same family: the mid-way switch, the second-model upscale, and a refine on a model split into UNET, text encoder and VAE files (Anima). A refine with a checkpoint of its own may cross families: rewrite its prompts in the new family's way. Anima's Tile fits its 2B models only (Anomalous refuses a run where it does not). A combination not tried here: say it is untried.

The second model is loaded bare. When the first stage has a style LoRA the user picked and they want that look kept, borrowing only the second model's skin or detail, add_lora it onto the second model too; leave it off only when they want the look changed.

These ways come from a few single-seed comparisons. A strong redraw changes faces, hands and small ornaments even with a lock: say what ran and what changed; promise no exact reproduction and no repaired hands.
